newsitem.title: USA: Rappaport voted NYMEX chairman for third term.
newsitem.headline: Rappaport voted NYMEX chairman for third term.

text.p: The New York Mercantile Exchange (NYMEX) said Daniel Rappaport was elected to his third term as chairman of the board.
Rappaport, who was first elected chairman in March of 1996, led the merger negotiations with the Commodity Exchange Inc (COMEX) in 1994.
Board members in five other categories were also elected,

Neil Citrone, vice president of Pioneer Futures Inc was elected in the futures commission merchant category; David Wender, was elected in the local category; and Scott Hess, a partner in G&H Commodities, was elected in the at-large category.

After serving on the COMEX board, Gary Cohn, a managing director of J. Aron/Goldman Sachs, was elected in the trade house category and Albert Helmig, the incumbent in the floor broker category, was elected to his third term.
